name: indicator_id
description: FDIC mnemonic of the line item
observations: Primary key; the value stored in financials_indicator

name: name
description: Readable name of the line item
observations: Derived from the FDIC title, which is published in capitals

name: description
description: Definition of the line item as published by the FDIC
observations: Empty for the line items the FDIC documents by title only

name: measurement_unit
description: Unit the value is expressed in: USD, percent or unit
observations: Classified from the FDIC title and description. Dollar amounts are converted from thousands to whole dollars at cleaning time

name: is_ratio
description: Whether the line item is a ratio computed by the FDIC

name: is_quarterly
description: Whether the line item covers the quarter rather than the year to date
observations: Income-statement items are year-to-date unless flagged here; the FDIC marks the quarterly variants with a Q suffix

name: is_flag
description: Whether the line item is a binary flag rather than a measure
observations: Flags are excluded from the financials table and appear in financials_indicator as 0 or 1

name: financials_column
description: Name of the matching column in the financials table
observations: Empty for the line items that are only available in financials_indicator
